message.content: Retrieval-augmented generation aims to address the problem of knowledge-intensive natural language processing (NLP) tasks by leveraging pre-trained language models to store factual knowledge in their parameters. These models have been shown to achieve state-of-the-art results when fine-tuned on downstream NLP tasks, such as open-domain question answering, fact checking, and long-form question answering. The approach involves using retrieval to improve performance across a variety of NLP tasks, including open-domain question answering, fact completion, and Wikipedia article generation.
